title: Hunger Games & Ender’s Game Lit Circles
summary: A four-week literature circle unit for grade 9: each group reads The Hunger Games or Ender’s Game, with two reading strategies a week, built-in reading quizzes, discussion and reflection.

steps.caption: The student view. Each group reads The Hunger Games or Ender’s Game, in four sections.
Every week starts with a question worth thinking about.
Both books use the same two reading strategies each week. The rubric comes first.
One strategy at a time, with a checklist beside the writing. It saves as they type.

steps.text: Katniss volunteers to take her younger sister's place in the reaping, and the two tributes leave for the Capitol.

steps.caption: Then a built-in reading quiz on their book, a group discussion, peer assessment and a reflection.
The teacher dashboard. Every step of every week is a tile.
Red numbers are work waiting for you. The reading quizzes are ready to approve and score themselves.
The rubric is right on the grading screen.
Click a score, then add a comment. Ready-made comments are one click away.
Everything saves on its own. Push grades to Canvas when you’re ready.

end.foot: Students need their own copy of the book. Your students’ work stays in your own Google Drive.
